description.value: Haidilao Hot Pot is a globally recognized Chinese hot pot chain whose first Canadian location opened in Richmond in December 2018. Diners choose up to four broth bases in a divided pot, then cook thinly sliced meats, seafood, and vegetables at the table — a communal, interactive meal well-suited to groups. The brand is widely known for elaborate tableside service and a broad menu spanning dozens of proteins, vegetables, and custom dipping sauces.
